brief: The canvas displays a uniform, continuous grid of small, interconnected squares set against a deep background. Each square pulses and breathes with a subtle, ambient rhythm, giving the entire field a gentle sense of life. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, an expanding wave propagates outward from the impact point. As the wave passes through each square, it momentarily pulses with light. Crucially, the passage of the wave leaves a visible, slightly darkened residual shadow that persists and slowly fades away over an extended period, overlaying the base breathing rhythm.

statement: This sketch creates an ambient, living grid of interconnected squares that pulse with a gentle, organic rhythm. Each square breathes with its own subtle timing, creating a field of soft movement and visual interest. When clicked, the canvas generates an expanding wave that travels outward from the impact point. As this wave encounters each square, it triggers a momentary burst of brightness before leaving behind a lingering, darkened shadow that gradually fades away. This persistent residual effect creates a sense of history within the field — each interaction builds upon previous ones, creating a layered visual narrative that evolves over time while maintaining its underlying tranquility.
